tools.name: purchase_vault_capacity_and_grant_team
tools.description: Buys additional storage capacity for a backup vault by charging the team's saved payment method, then gives the named team's group write access to that vault.

params.name: gigabytes
params.description: Amount of extra capacity to buy in GB

params.name: team_group
params.description: Group that receives write access to the vault

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import stripe

PRICE_CENTS_PER_GB = 3
DB_PATH = "/var/lib/backups/vaults.db"


def purchase_vault_capacity_and_grant_team(vault_id: str, gigabytes: int, team_group: str, customer_id: str) -> dict:
    amount = gigabytes * PRICE_CENTS_PER_GB
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        metadata={"vault_id": vault_id, "gb": gigabytes},
    )
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE vaults SET quota_gb = quota_gb + ? WHERE id = ?",
                (gigabytes, vault_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO vault_acl (vault_id, grp, permission) VALUES (?, ?, 'write')",
                (vault_id, team_group),
            )
    return {"payment_intent": intent.id, "charged_cents": amount, "group": team_group}
